m: While your **eyes** **watch**, it's coming: **soon**, any moment.
ex: 眼看就要下雨了，快回家吧。
It's about to rain, let's hurry home.
眼看考试就要到了。
The exam is just around the corner.
use: Often 眼看就要…了, something is about to happen.

ex: 我们要强化安全意识。
We need to strengthen safety awareness.
考试前老师给我们做了强化训练。
Before the exam, the teacher gave us intensive training.
use: Formal; 强化训练, intensive training.

ex: 他试图说服我。
He tried to persuade me.
小偷试图逃跑，但被抓住了。
The thief tried to run away but was caught.
use: Written; followed by a verb, often a failed try.

m: The **lining** of your **old** place: your **home town**.
ex: 这里是诗人的故里。
This is the poet's home town.
他退休后回到了故里。
After retiring he went back to his home town.
use: Literary; often for famous people's birthplaces.

ex: 这辆车运送货物。
This lorry carries goods.
货物已经到了仓库。
The goods have reached the warehouse.
use: Measure word 批 (batch).

m: It does **not** **hinder** you: **might as well**, no harm in.
ex: 你不妨试一试。
You might as well give it a try.
有问题不妨直接问老师。
If you have questions, there's no harm asking the teacher directly.
use: A gentle suggestion; before a verb.

m: The **words** of one **square** of land: a **dialect**.
ex: 我听不懂这里的方言。
I can't understand the local dialect.
他说的是四川方言。
He speaks Sichuan dialect.
use: 普通话 is standard Mandarin.

ex: 这家公司很会用人。
This company is good at making use of its people.
用人单位很看重工作经验。
Employers value work experience highly.
use: 用人单位 means employer; a servant is usually 佣人.

m: The **head rope** of a net and its **neck**: a **programme**, guiding principle.
ex: 这是党的基本纲领。
This is the party's basic programme.
会议通过了行动纲领。
The meeting adopted a programme of action.
use: Formal, political.

ex: 他转头看了我一眼。
He turned his head and glanced at me.
听到声音，她马上转头。
Hearing a sound, she turned her head at once.
use: Also 转过头.

m: A **boat**'s or plane's scheduled **team** run: a **flight**.
ex: 我们的航班晚点了。
Our flight is delayed.
去上海的航班几点起飞？
What time does the flight to Shanghai take off?
use: Measure word 个 or 趟.

m: A particle that has **left** its balance: an **ion**.
ex: 这种水含有很多离子。
This water contains lots of ions.
离子带电。
Ions carry an electric charge.
use: Chemistry and physics term.

ex: 这艘航母非常大。
This aircraft carrier is huge.
中国有自己的航母。
China has its own aircraft carriers.
use: Short for 航空母舰; measure word 艘.

m: The **nature** of **amassing** energy to the **extreme**: **enthusiasm**, initiative.
ex: 老师要调动学生的积极性。
Teachers should motivate students.
他的工作积极性很高。
He's very keen on his work.
use: Goes with 调动 (arouse), 提高, 高.

ex: 斯巴达是古希腊的一个城邦。
Sparta was a city-state in ancient Greece.
斯巴达的士兵非常勇敢。
Spartan soldiers were very brave.
use: Foreign name written for its sound.

ex: 祝你有一个美好的未来。
Wishing you a bright future.
那是一段美好的回忆。
That's a lovely memory.
use: For life, future, memories; rarely for looks.

ex: 他不轻易相信别人。
He doesn't trust people easily.
成功不是轻易就能得到的。
Success doesn't come easily.
use: Often with 不: 不轻易, not lightly.

ex: 我们一定能克服困难。
We can certainly overcome the difficulties.
他克服了紧张，上台讲话了。
He overcame his nerves and went up to speak.
use: Objects: 困难, 缺点, 恐惧.

ex: 我妈妈是会计。
My mum is an accountant.
他在大学学的是会计。
He studied accounting at university.
use: 会 is read kuài here.

ex: 山里的通讯不太好。
Communications aren't good in the mountains.
通讯技术发展得很快。
Communications technology is developing fast.
use: Also spelled 通信 for telecoms; 通讯录 is a contact list.

ex: 黑龙江冬天非常冷。
Heilongjiang is extremely cold in winter.
我朋友是黑龙江人。
My friend is from Heilongjiang.
use: Also the Amur River.

ex: 这本书很有趣。
This book is very interesting.
他是一个很有趣的人。
He's a really fun person.
use: Similar to 有意思, which is more spoken.

m: A **fire** **car**, from the old steam engines: a **train**.
ex: 我们坐火车去北京吧。
Let's go to Beijing by train.
火车站离这儿很远。
The train station is far from here.
use: Measure word 列 or 趟.

ex: 我们终于到了目的地。
We finally reached our destination.
你的目的地是哪里？
Where is your destination?
use: Note 的 is dì here, as in 目的.

ex: 元代的首都是大都。
The Yuan capital was Dadu.
这幅画是元代的。
This painting is from the Yuan dynasty.
use: 代 here means era.

ex: 中国地域很广。
China covers a vast area.
不同地域的饮食习惯不一样。
Eating habits differ between regions.
use: Often 地域文化, regional culture.

ex: 他把手掌放在桌上。
He put his palm on the table.
我的手掌出汗了。
My palms are sweating.
use: Opposite side is 手背, back of the hand.

ex: 运动对身体有益。
Exercise is good for the body.
这是一次有益的讨论。
This was a useful discussion.
use: Pattern 对…有益, good for.

ex: 这部电影的题材很新。
The subject of this film is fresh.
他喜欢写历史题材的小说。
He likes writing novels on historical themes.
use: For books, films, art.

ex: 朋友们都来安慰她。
Her friends all came to comfort her.
你的话对我是很大的安慰。
Your words are a great comfort to me.
use: Takes a person as object.

ex: 我每天早上浏览新闻。
I skim the news every morning.
他在网上浏览了很多网站。
He browsed lots of websites.
use: 浏览器 is a web browser.

m: Put your **hand** **out**: **make a move**, act; spend money.
ex: 他一出手就解决了问题。
He solved the problem as soon as he stepped in.
她出手很大方。
She spends very generously.
use: Also selling: 房子出手了, the house sold.

m: **Go forward** into the **city walls**: **go into town**.
ex: 我明天进城买东西。
I'm going into town tomorrow to shop.
很多农民进城打工。
Many farmers go to the cities to work.
use: From the countryside or suburbs into the city.

ex: 他一开口大家就笑了。
Everyone laughed as soon as he opened his mouth.
我不好意思开口借钱。
I'm too embarrassed to ask to borrow money.
use: Often about speaking up or asking for something.

ex: 这里主要的农作物是水稻。
The main crop here is rice.
干旱影响了农作物生长。
The drought affected crop growth.
use: Collective; measure word 种.

m: **Hold** it in your hand once it **reaches** you: **get**, obtain.
ex: 我拿到驾照了！
I got my driving licence!
你拿到钥匙了吗？
Did you get the keys?
use: Result verb: success in getting.

m: **Recognize** and **fix** it in your mind: **firmly believe**, determine.
ex: 他认定自己是对的。
He's convinced he's right.
这件事已经被认定为事故。
This has been officially ruled an accident.
use: Also official rulings: 被认定为.

ex: 他力气很大。
He's very strong.
我累得没力气说话了。
I'm too tired to even talk.
use: Goes with 大, 小, 没有; 花力气, put in effort.

ex: 我不敢看恐怖电影。
I don't dare watch horror films.
那个场面太恐怖了。
That scene was terrifying.
use: Also 恐怖分子, terrorist.

ex: 鲜花给房间增添了色彩。
The flowers added colour to the room.
给你们增添麻烦了。
Sorry for adding to your trouble.
use: Objects: 色彩, 乐趣, 麻烦.

ex: 这件事促使我改变了想法。
This prompted me to change my mind.
压力促使他更加努力。
Pressure spurred him to work harder.
use: Pattern 促使 + someone + verb.

ex: 这份工作要求本科学历。
This job requires a bachelor's degree.
他的学历很高。
He's highly educated.
use: Highest qualification; 学位 is the degree itself.

ex: 他否定了这个计划。
He rejected this plan.
她给了一个否定的回答。
She gave a negative answer.
use: Opposite 肯定.

ex: 夜里下了一场大雨。
There was heavy rain in the night.
他常常夜里工作。
He often works at night.
use: Spoken; also 夜里头.

ex: 我承受不了这么大的压力。
I can't bear this much pressure.
这座桥能承受很重的车。
This bridge can bear heavy vehicles.
use: Objects: 压力, 痛苦, 重量.

m: An expert in the **politics** of **ruling**: a **statesman**.
ex: 他是一位伟大的政治家。
He was a great statesman.
她想成为政治家。
She wants to become a politician.
use: Respectful; 政客 is a negative word for politician.

ex: 白天我要上班。
I have to work during the day.
白天和晚上温差很大。
There's a big temperature difference between day and night.
use: Opposite 晚上 or 夜里.

ex: 她脸上露出了笑容。
A smile appeared on her face.
孩子的笑容很可爱。
The child's smile is lovely.
use: Goes with 露出 and 满脸.

m: One who **takes charge** of the **machine**: a **driver**.
ex: 司机师傅，请在这里停车。
Driver, please stop here.
他是出租车司机。
He's a taxi driver.
use: Polite address: 司机师傅.

ex: 他未能按时完成。
He failed to finish on time.
由于大雨，飞机未能起飞。
Because of the heavy rain, the plane couldn't take off.
use: Written for 没能.

m: **Go back** and **look after** the past: **look back on**, review.
ex: 我们回顾一下上节课的内容。
Let's review what we covered last lesson.
回顾过去一年，我学到了很多。
Looking back on the past year, I've learned a lot.
use: Formal; 回忆 is personal memories.

ex: 他考了第一名，很得意。
He came first in the exam and is very pleased with himself.
别太得意了！
Don't get too cocky!
use: Often slightly negative: smug; 得意洋洋, gloating.

ex: 日本古代有很多武士。
Ancient Japan had many samurai.
武士手里拿着一把刀。
The warrior held a sword in his hand.
use: Often for Japanese samurai.

m: **Form** and **establish**: **set up** a team or body.
ex: 学校组建了一支足球队。
The school set up a football team.
他们组建了一个新公司。
They formed a new company.
use: For teams, groups, organizations.

ex: 这天早上，下起了大雨。
That morning it started pouring with rain.
我永远不会忘记这天。
I'll never forget this day.
use: Storytelling: refers to a day already mentioned.

ex: 妈妈用莲子煮了一锅汤。
Mum made a pot of soup with lotus seeds.
莲子吃起来有点苦。
Lotus seeds taste a little bitter.
use: Common in soups and mooncake fillings.

ex: 我们中午一起吃饭吧。
Let's have lunch together at midday.
中午我常常睡一会儿。
I often have a nap at noon.
use: 午饭 or 中午饭 is lunch.

ex: 女士们，先生们，晚上好！
Ladies and gentlemen, good evening!
王女士，请到这边来。
Ms Wang, please come this way.
use: Polite; surname + 女士.

ex: 国会通过了这项法律。
Parliament passed this law.
他是美国国会议员。
He's a member of the US Congress.
use: For foreign legislatures; China's is 全国人大.

ex: 别找借口了。
Stop making excuses.
他借口身体不舒服没来上班。
He didn't come to work, using illness as an excuse.
use: Goes with 找: 找借口.

ex: 市长来工厂视察。
The mayor came to inspect the factory.
领导视察了新学校。
The leaders inspected the new school.
use: Formal: someone senior inspecting.

m: **Calculate** and **plan** the **birth** and **raising** of children: **family planning**.
ex: 中国以前实行计划生育政策。
China used to have a family planning policy.
他在计划生育部门工作。
He works in the family planning department.
use: Usually refers to China's population policy.

ex: 他每天跑步，以此锻炼身体。
He runs every day to keep fit.
我们以此为例来说明。
Let's take this as an example to explain.
use: Written; 以此为…, take this as….

ex: 你何以知道这件事？
How do you know about this?
何以解忧？唯有读书。
How can I ease my worries? Only by reading.
use: Literary; spoken 怎么 or 为什么.

ex: 病人已经清醒了。
The patient has regained consciousness.
喝了咖啡我才清醒一点。
I only feel a bit more awake after coffee.
use: Also clear-headed judgment: 头脑清醒.

ex: 这个城市的面貌变化很大。
The city's appearance has changed a lot.
我记不清他的面貌了。
I can't clearly remember what he looked like.
use: Often for a place's overall look; 精神面貌, mental outlook.

ex: 士兵们明天出征。
The soldiers set off to war tomorrow.
国家队出征世界杯。
The national team sets off for the World Cup.
use: Also used for sports teams setting off for a tournament.

ex: 吃完饭别马上跑，不好消化。
Don't run right after eating, it's bad for digestion.
这么多知识我一下子消化不了。
I can't take in this much knowledge all at once.
use: Also figurative: absorb information.

ex: 他的手指很灵活。
His fingers are very nimble.
我们的工作时间很灵活。
Our working hours are very flexible.
use: For bodies, minds and arrangements.

ex: 银行提高了利率。
The bank raised the interest rate.
现在的存款利率很低。
Savings interest rates are very low now.
use: 率 is lǜ here, a rate.

ex: 今年工资增长的幅度不大。
Pay rises this year were small.
价格变化的幅度很大。
Prices have changed a great deal.
use: Size of a change; often with 大, 小.

m: The **ministry** of **households**: the imperial **Ministry of Revenue**.
ex: 户部负责管理国家的钱粮。
The Ministry of Revenue managed the state's money and grain.
他在户部当官。
He was an official in the Ministry of Revenue.
use: Historical; one of the Six Boards.

ex: 每人一张票。
One ticket per person.
我们每人交了五十块钱。
Each of us paid fifty yuan.
use: Often with numbers: 每人一个.

m: A **wicked** **Han** man who sells out his own side: a **traitor** to China.
ex: 电影里的汉奸最后被抓住了。
The traitor in the film was caught in the end.
他被人骂成汉奸。
He was branded a traitor.
use: Strong insult, mostly about wartime collaborators.

m: **Cannot** **not** do it: **have to**, can't help but.
ex: 这件事我不能不管。
I can't stay out of this.
他说得太好了，我不能不佩服。
He spoke so well I couldn't help admiring him.
use: Double negative for a strong must.

ex: 这个政策很得人心。
This policy is very popular.
人心都是肉长的。
Everyone has a heart.
use: 得人心 means win popular support.

ex: 事情已然发生了，后悔也没用。
It has already happened; regret is useless.
他已然成为了一名优秀的医生。
He has already become an excellent doctor.
use: Written; spoken 已经.

ex: 故宫以前是皇宫。
The Forbidden City used to be the imperial palace.
皇帝住在皇宫里。
The emperor lived in the palace.
use: Measure word 座.

ex: 目前尚无消息。
There's no news yet.
这种病尚无有效的治疗方法。
There is still no effective treatment for this disease.
use: Written; spoken 还没有.

ex: 这本教材很适合初学者。
This textbook is good for beginners.
老师给我们发了新教材。
The teacher handed out new textbooks.
use: Measure word 本 or 套.

ex: 他比先前胖了。
He's fatter than before.
先前的计划已经取消了。
The earlier plan has been cancelled.
use: Like 以前 but a bit more written.

ex: 祝你一路平安。
Have a safe journey.
听到你平安到家，我就放心了。
Now that I know you got home safely, I can relax.
use: Fixed wishes: 一路平安, 平安夜 (Christmas Eve).

ex: 这里是大学的旧址。
This is the university's former site.
会议旧址现在是一个博物馆。
The old meeting site is now a museum.
use: For historic places; often on plaques.

ex: 服务业在经济中占主导地位。
The service sector plays a dominant role in the economy.
这个项目由她主导。
She is leading this project.
use: 主导地位 means a dominant position.

ex: 他晚上常常跟朋友喝酒。
He often drinks with friends in the evening.
喝酒以后不能开车。
You can't drive after drinking.
use: Separable: 喝了一点酒.

m: **Spread out** for people to **look at**: an **exhibition**.
ex: 我们周末去看展览吧。
Let's go see an exhibition at the weekend.
博物馆正在展览古代的画。
The museum is exhibiting ancient paintings.
use: 展览会 or 展览馆 for the event and hall.

ex: 这里的水质很好。
The water quality here is good.
工厂污染了河流的水质。
The factory polluted the river's water.
use: Used in environmental talk.

ex: 我们穿过公园去学校。
We cut through the park to school.
火车穿过了一条长长的隧道。
The train went through a long tunnel.
use: Object is the place passed through.

ex: 这个村子的耕地很少。
This village has very little farmland.
农民正在用牛耕地。
The farmer is ploughing with an ox.
use: As a noun, arable land.

ex: 部队回到了驻地。
The troops returned to their base.
记者的驻地在城外。
The reporters were based outside the city.
use: For troops, teams, offices.

ex: 存钱在银行可以拿到利息。
You get interest by saving money in a bank.
这笔贷款的利息很高。
The interest on this loan is very high.
use: Measure word 笔.

ex: 她是一个勇敢的女孩。
She is a brave girl.
勇敢一点，你可以的！
Be brave, you can do it!
use: Everyday word; 英勇 is more heroic.

m: The **straight** main **text**: the **body** of a text.
ex: 请先看正文，再看注释。
Read the main text first, then the notes.
邮件的正文写得太长了。
The body of the email is too long.
use: Opposite 标题 (title) or 注释 (notes).

ex: 战士们英勇作战。
The soldiers fought heroically.
他的英勇行为得到了表扬。
His heroic act was praised.
use: Formal, about soldiers and rescuers.

ex: 电影的高潮部分很精彩。
The film's climax is brilliant.
晚会进入了高潮。
The party reached its high point.
use: Mostly the climax of a story or event.

ex: 请两个人练习这段对话。
Practise this dialogue in pairs.
两国领导人进行了对话。
The two countries' leaders held talks.
use: Also formal talks between sides.

ex: 病毒侵入了身体。
The virus entered the body.
有人侵入了公司的电脑系统。
Someone hacked into the company's computer system.
use: For armies, viruses, hackers.

ex: 别分散注意力。
Don't get distracted.
村子里的房子很分散。
The houses in the village are spread out.
use: 分散注意力, distract attention.

ex: 人紧张的时候会分泌更多汗水。
People sweat more when they're nervous.
这种激素是身体自己分泌的。
This hormone is secreted by the body itself.
use: Biology word.

m: A **clique** sharing a **learning**: a **school of thought**.
ex: 他属于哪个学派？
Which school of thought does he belong to?
这个学派影响很大。
This school of thought is very influential.
use: For philosophy, art and science.

ex: 我们的谈话就此结束。
Our conversation ends here.
这件事不能就此算了。
We can't just let this matter drop here.
use: Written; 就此结束, 就此告别.

ex: 我在网上注册了一个账号。
I registered an account online.
新生明天去学校注册。
New students register at the school tomorrow.
use: For accounts, companies, students.

ex: 他不来，也就是说会要改时间。
He isn't coming, which means the meeting has to move.
也就是说，我们还有三天时间。
In other words, we have three days left.
use: Starts a restatement or conclusion.

m: Two **awkward** characters for an **embarrassing** spot: **awkward**, embarrassed.
ex: 我叫错了他的名字，真尴尬。
I called him by the wrong name, so embarrassing.
气氛一下子变得很尴尬。
The atmosphere suddenly became awkward.
use: Very common in speech, for people and situations.

m: An **area** where people were **divided** from chains and **set** free: a **liberated area**.
ex: 他小时候住在解放区。
He lived in a liberated area as a child.
很多青年去了解放区。
Many young people went to the liberated areas.
use: Historical, Communist-held areas before 1949; also a district name.

ex: 你这样说太过分了。
Saying that is going too far.
不要过分担心。
Don't worry too much.
use: 太过分了 means that's out of line.

m: A **dragon** **head** spouting water: a **tap**; also the leader.
ex: 请把水龙头关上。
Please turn off the tap.
这家公司是行业的龙头。
This company is the industry leader.
use: Tap is usually 水龙头; 龙头企业, a leading firm.

ex: 实验室里有很多仪器。
There are many instruments in the lab.
这台仪器很贵。
This instrument is very expensive.
use: Measure word 台; scientific equipment.

ex: 故事至此结束。
The story ends here.
至此，比赛已经进行了一半。
At this point, the match is half over.
use: Written.

ex: 他很少离开本国。
He rarely leaves his own country.
我们要保护本国的文化。
We must protect our own country's culture.
use: Opposite 外国.

ex: 内蒙古有很大的草原。
Inner Mongolia has vast grasslands.
我们夏天去内蒙古骑马。
We go horse riding in Inner Mongolia in summer.
use: An autonomous region of China; 蒙古 alone is Mongolia.

ex: 两国要深化合作。
The two countries want to deepen cooperation.
我们要深化改革。
We must deepen reform.
use: Formal; objects 改革, 合作, 认识.

ex: 你需要论证你的观点。
You need to back up your argument.
这篇文章论证得很清楚。
This article argues its case very clearly.
use: Academic; also feasibility study: 可行性论证.

ex: 我的几何学得不太好。
I'm not very good at geometry.
几何课上我们学了三角形。
We learned about triangles in geometry class.
use: Literary: 人生几何, how long is life.

ex: 这个月的支出太多了。
Expenses this month were too high.
我们要减少不必要的支出。
We must cut unnecessary spending.
use: Opposite 收入, income.

ex: 她在一家公司做营销。
She works in marketing at a company.
这个产品的营销做得很好。
This product was marketed very well.
use: 网络营销, online marketing.

ex: 他腹部有点疼。
He has a slight pain in his abdomen.
这个动作可以锻炼腹部。
This exercise works the abdomen.
use: Medical and formal; 肚子 in speech.

ex: 海外同胞也很关心祖国。
Compatriots overseas also care about their homeland.
他们是同胞兄弟。
They are brothers by the same parents.
use: Often 同胞 for compatriots.

ex: 医生帮我检测了血液。
The doctor tested my blood.
这个仪器可以检测空气质量。
This device can detect air quality.
use: Technical testing; 检查 is a general check.

ex: 春天来了，花都开了。
Spring has come and the flowers are out.
我最喜欢春天。
I like spring best.
use: Formal 春季.

ex: 我们制订了一个学习计划。
We drew up a study plan.
公司正在制订新的规定。
The company is drawing up new rules.
use: Objects 计划, 方案; 制定 is close, more for laws.

ex: 他手下有十几个人。
He has a dozen or so people under him.
我在她手下工作了三年。
I worked under her for three years.
use: Spoken; can sound like gang slang for henchmen.

ex: 昆明四季如春。
Kunming is like spring all year round.
我们坐飞机去昆明。
We're flying to Kunming.
use: Known as the City of Eternal Spring, 春城.

m: **Along** the old path, still **use** it: **keep using**.
ex: 这个名字一直沿用到今天。
This name is still used today.
公司沿用了以前的做法。
The company kept using the old method.
use: For names, methods, rules carried on.

ex: 她总是一张笑脸。
She always has a smile on her face.
他在信的最后画了一个笑脸。
He drew a smiley at the end of the letter.
use: Measure word 张.

ex: 我们需要评估一下风险。
We need to assess the risks.
专家对这个项目做了评估。
Experts did an assessment of the project.
use: Formal and business.

m: **Leave** off **saying** it: **let alone**, not to mention.
ex: 我连饭都没吃，别说喝咖啡了。
I haven't even eaten, let alone had coffee.
别说是你，就是老师也不会。
Never mind you, even the teacher can't do it.
use: Pattern A 都没…，别说 B 了.

ex: 他说话的口气很不客气。
He spoke in a very rude tone.
听他的口气，好像不太高兴。
From his tone, he doesn't seem happy.
use: Also 口气大, boastful.

ex: 谢谢你！不客气！
Thank you! You're welcome!
你太客气了。
You're too kind.
use: 不客气 replies to thanks; 别客气, make yourself at home.

ex: 他连连点头。
He nodded again and again.
观众连连叫好。
The audience cheered over and over.
use: Before verbs: 连连道歉, apologize repeatedly.

ex: 我的生日在三月。
My birthday is in March.
三月的天气还有点冷。
The weather in March is still a bit cold.
use: Months are number + 月.

ex: 牛顿发现了三大定律。
Newton discovered three great laws.
这是一个自然定律。
This is a law of nature.
use: Science; 法律 is a legal law.

ex: 这个包很实用。
This bag is very practical.
这本书里有很多实用的建议。
This book has lots of practical advice.
use: Opposite 不实用; 实用性, practicality.

m: South of the **Ji** river, where you **cross**: **Jinan**, capital of Shandong.
ex: 济南有很多泉水。
Jinan has many springs.
我在济南上的大学。
I went to university in Jinan.
use: Called the City of Springs, 泉城.

ex: 这家超市东西很齐全。
This supermarket has everything.
你的材料都齐全了吗？
Do you have all your documents?
use: For goods, documents, equipment.

ex: 义军打进了城。
The rebel army fought its way into the city.
他带领义军反抗官府。
He led a rebel army against the government.
use: Historical, a sympathetic word for rebels.

ex: 这里开采煤炭。
Coal is mined here.
这座山的矿已经开采完了。
The ore in this mountain has all been mined.
use: For minerals, oil, gas.

ex: 北宋的首都是开封。
The Northern Song capital was Kaifeng.
这是一幅北宋的画。
This is a Northern Song painting.
use: Followed by 南宋, Southern Song.

ex: 可不，我也这么想。
Exactly, that's what I think too.
今天真冷！可不是嘛。
It's really cold today! It sure is.
use: Spoken agreement; also 可不是.

ex: 这个城市水运很方便。
Water transport is convenient in this city.
水运比陆运便宜。
Shipping by water is cheaper than by land.
use: Contrast 陆运 and 空运.

ex: 他的笑容犹如阳光。
His smile is like sunshine.
这里的风景犹如画一样。
The scenery here is like a painting.
use: Literary; spoken 好像 or 像.

ex: 这是生死攸关的问题。
This is a matter of life and death.
他们是生死之交。
They are friends for life and death.
use: Fixed: 生死攸关, 生死之交.

ex: 这个耳机是双声道的。
These headphones are stereo.
电影有中文和英文两个声道。
The film has Chinese and English audio tracks.
use: Technical audio word.

m: The **heart** and its **spirit**: the **soul**, inner self.
ex: 音乐可以安慰人的心灵。
Music can comfort the soul.
她有一颗美丽的心灵。
She has a beautiful soul.
use: Also 心灵手巧, clever and skilful.

ex: 孩子们欢欢喜喜地过新年。
The children joyfully celebrate New Year.
他心里很欢喜。
He's very happy inside.
use: A bit old or regional; often 欢欢喜喜.

ex: 我明天给你答复。
I'll give you an answer tomorrow.
公司还没有答复我们。
The company hasn't replied to us yet.
use: More formal than 回答; for requests and applications.

m: Hold a **position** and **occupy** it: **rank**, be located at.
ex: 这个城市人口位居全国第三。
The city ranks third in the country by population.
他的成绩位居全班第一。
His grades rank first in his class.
use: Formal; followed by a ranking.

ex: 我想把美元兑换成人民币。
I'd like to change dollars into renminbi.
机场可以兑换外币。
You can exchange foreign currency at the airport.
use: Pattern 把 A 兑换成 B.

ex: 中方希望双方合作。
The Chinese side hopes for cooperation.
中方代表参加了会议。
Chinese representatives attended the meeting.
use: News and diplomacy; 美方 the US side.

ex: 我今年二十岁。
I'm twenty this year.
教室里有二十个学生。
There are twenty students in the classroom.
use: Not 两十; always 二十.

ex: 我常常回忆小时候的事。
I often think back to my childhood.
那是一段美好的回忆。
That's a lovely memory.
use: Personal memories; 记忆 is memory as a faculty.

m: **Increase** by **setting up** more: **add** a new facility or service.
ex: 学校增设了两门新课。
The school added two new courses.
火车站增设了售票窗口。
The station has opened more ticket windows.
use: Formal; objects 课程, 窗口, 部门.

m: **Take the lid off** and leave it out like **dew**: **expose**, unmask.
ex: 记者揭露了这家公司的问题。
The reporter exposed the company's problems.
真相终于被揭露了。
The truth was finally exposed.
use: For wrongdoing, lies, secrets.

ex: 新加坡很干净。
Singapore is very clean.
我在新加坡工作过两年。
I worked in Singapore for two years.
use: Country and city name.

m: A **golden** week that **goes round** each year: **Golden Week** holiday.
ex: 黄金周的时候到处都是人。
There are crowds everywhere during Golden Week.
今年黄金周你去哪儿玩？
Where are you going for Golden Week this year?
use: China's week-long National Day holiday in October.

m: The **countryside** where you **once** lived: your **home town**.
ex: 我很想念我的故乡。
I really miss my home town.
他退休后回到了故乡。
He returned to his home town after retiring.
use: Emotional, literary; spoken 老家 or 家乡.

ex: 这种鸟非常罕见。
This bird is very rare.
今年冬天下了一场罕见的大雪。
There was a rare heavy snowfall this winter.
use: For unusual events and things.

m: **Rise** and **reach**: **have** an effect, play a role.
ex: 这个办法起到了很好的效果。
This method had a very good effect.
老师起到了很重要的作用。
The teacher played a very important role.
use: Fixed pattern 起到…作用 or 效果.

ex: 这部电影我看了三次。
I've seen this film three times.
他一天刷三次牙。
He brushes his teeth three times a day.
use: 次 counts times; 第三次 is the third time.

ex: 机动车不能进入这条街。
Motor vehicles may not enter this street.
我们留了一些机动时间。
We left some flexible time.
use: 机动车 is motor vehicle.

m: **North** of the **river**: **Jiangbei**, an area or district.
ex: 重庆的机场在江北。
Chongqing's airport is in Jiangbei.
我家住在江北区。
My home is in Jiangbei District.
use: District name in several cities; also land north of the Yangtze.

ex: 大雨致使交通中断。
The heavy rain caused traffic to stop.
他的错误致使公司损失很大。
His mistake caused the company big losses.
use: Formal, usually for bad results.

m: **Open** it so things **go through**: **open**, launch a service.
ex: 新地铁线下个月开通。
The new metro line opens next month.
我开通了手机银行。
I activated mobile banking.
use: For transport lines and services; also open-minded.

m: A **plan** made in the **shade**: a **plot**, conspiracy.
ex: 他们的阴谋被发现了。
Their plot was discovered.
这是一个阴谋。
This is a conspiracy.
use: 阴谋论 is conspiracy theory.

ex: 他被调动到北京工作。
He was transferred to work in Beijing.
老师很会调动学生的积极性。
The teacher is good at motivating students.
use: 调 is diào here; 调动积极性, motivate.

ex: 问题的实质是钱不够。
The heart of the problem is a lack of money.
双方没有实质性的进展。
The two sides made no real progress.
use: 实质上, in essence; 实质性, substantive.

ex: 这里处处都是鲜花。
There are flowers everywhere here.
他处处为别人着想。
He always thinks of others in everything.
use: Before the verb; like 到处.

ex: 请你叙述一下事情的经过。
Please describe what happened.
这本书叙述了一个家庭的故事。
This book tells the story of a family.
use: Written; spoken 讲 or 说.

ex: 我每天早上喝一杯咖啡。
I drink a cup of coffee every morning.
我们去咖啡馆坐坐吧。
Let's go and sit in a café.
use: Measure word 杯.

ex: 那条鱼还活着。
That fish is still alive.
活着就有希望。
Where there's life, there's hope.
use: 着 marks an ongoing state.

m: The **swallow**'s **capital**: **Yanjing**, an old name for Beijing.
ex: 燕京是北京的旧称。
Yanjing is an old name for Beijing.
他喝的是燕京啤酒。
He's drinking Yanjing beer.
use: Seen in brand names like 燕京啤酒.

ex: 粉丝们都疯狂了。
The fans went wild.
这真是一个疯狂的想法。
That's a really crazy idea.
use: Also adverb: 疯狂地购物, shop like crazy.

m: **One** **thread** at the very front: the **front line**; first-tier.
ex: 医生们在一线工作。
Doctors are working on the front line.
北京和上海是一线城市。
Beijing and Shanghai are first-tier cities.
use: 一线城市, the biggest cities; 一线希望, a ray of hope.

ex: 夜间开车要小心。
Be careful driving at night.
这家药店夜间也营业。
This pharmacy is also open at night.
use: Formal; 夜间模式 is night mode.

m: **Send out** and **put** in hands: **hand out**, issue.
ex: 学校给学生发放了奖学金。
The school awarded scholarships to students.
公司每月十号发放工资。
The company pays wages on the tenth of each month.
use: Formal; for money, goods, documents.

ex: 他把孩子放在肩头。
He put the child on his shoulder.
我们肩头的责任很重。
We carry heavy responsibilities on our shoulders.
use: Literary or regional for 肩膀.

ex: 这家店只零售，不批发。
This shop only sells retail, not wholesale.
零售价格比较高。
The retail price is higher.
use: Opposite 批发, wholesale.

ex: 一年有十二个月。
There are twelve months in a year.
现在是中午十二点。
It's twelve noon.
use: 十二生肖 are the twelve zodiac animals.

ex: 他是一位空军少将。
He is an air force major general.
她五十岁时当上了少将。
She became a major general at fifty.
use: 少 is shào here; 中将 lieutenant general.

ex: 我到的时候，他恰好出去了。
When I arrived, he just happened to have gone out.
这些钱恰好够买一张票。
This money is just enough for one ticket.
use: Like 正好.

m: **No** **matter** **how** or **what**: **in any case**, no matter what.
ex: 无论如何，你都要来。
Whatever happens, you have to come.
我无论如何也想不起来他的名字。
No matter how hard I try, I can't remember his name.
use: Followed by 都 or 也.

ex: 警察逮捕了那个人。
The police arrested that man.
他因为偷东西被逮捕了。
He was arrested for theft.
use: Formal and legal; 抓 is spoken.

ex: 学校给他颁发了奖状。
The school awarded him a certificate.
政府颁发了新的规定。
The government issued new regulations.
use: For awards, certificates, licences.

ex: 这是一张很珍贵的照片。
This is a very precious photo.
时间是最珍贵的。
Time is the most precious thing.
use: For things of great value, often sentimental.

ex: 美洲包括北美和南美。
The Americas include North and South America.
她去美洲旅行了一个月。
She travelled around the Americas for a month.
use: 美 here is short for America.

m: **Bent** and **broken** back and forth: **winding**, twists and turns.
ex: 这条山路很曲折。
This mountain road is very winding.
故事情节很曲折。
The story has lots of twists and turns.
use: For roads, stories and experiences.

ex: 看到这张照片，我联想到了小时候。
Seeing this photo reminds me of my childhood.
我的电脑是联想的。
My computer is a Lenovo.
use: Pattern 联想到, be reminded of.

ex: 大雨迫使比赛停止。
The heavy rain forced the match to stop.
经济困难迫使他卖了房子。
Money troubles forced him to sell his house.
use: Pattern 迫使 + someone + verb.

ex: 这座城市融合了东西方文化。
This city blends Eastern and Western culture.
两种音乐融合得很好。
The two kinds of music blend well.
use: For cultures, ideas, peoples.

ex: 那个女孩是我妹妹。
That girl is my younger sister.
她是一个很可爱的女孩。
She's a very sweet girl.
use: Also 女孩子; 男孩 is boy.

ex: 他考了第五名。
He came fifth in the exam.
今天是我来中国的第五天。
Today is my fifth day in China.
use: 第 + number makes an ordinal.

ex: 这个箱子体积很大。
This box is very big.
水结冰以后体积会变大。
Water expands when it freezes.
use: Space taken up; 容量 is capacity.

ex: 你要定期去看牙医。
You should see the dentist regularly.
我们每月定期开会。
We hold a regular meeting every month.
use: Also fixed-term deposit: 定期存款.

m: A **period** with a **limit**: a **deadline**, time limit.
ex: 这份工作的期限是三个月。
This job lasts three months.
你必须在期限内交作业。
You must hand in your homework by the deadline.
use: Fixed time limit; 截止日期 is the deadline date.

m: **Use** it **to**: **in order to**, so as to.
ex: 他举了个例子，用以说明问题。
He gave an example to illustrate the point.
这笔钱用以帮助贫困学生。
This money is used to help poor students.
use: Written style.

ex: 她哭得很伤心。
She cried her heart out.
别伤心了，会好起来的。
Don't be sad, it will get better.
use: Stronger than 难过.

ex: 他在电信公司上班。
He works at a telecoms company.
中国电信是一家大公司。
China Telecom is a big company.
use: Also 电信诈骗, phone scams.

ex: 银行可以买卖外汇。
Banks can buy and sell foreign currency.
国家的外汇储备很多。
The country has large foreign exchange reserves.
use: Finance word.

ex: 他从不喝酒。
He never drinks.
我从不在晚上喝咖啡。
I never drink coffee in the evening.
use: For habits; 从没 is for past experiences.

ex: 项目前期准备很重要。
Early preparation for a project is very important.
前期的工作已经完成了。
The early-stage work is done.
use: Opposite 后期; often 前期准备.
